Hi Anton,

We have sent you a few mails on "Marvell Alleycat5 Solution" and you never had a reason to answer — fair enough. No brochure this time, just one question:

For mining and plant-floor nodes where Westermo is over-spec — a Marvell-based managed DIN 8-PoE + 2-SFP (ring redundancy, −40~75  C, CE/FCC) at $79 EXW; not for rail or nuclear. Worth one evaluation unit?

If it is not relevant now, a one-word reply is enough and I will take you off the catalog mails.

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
